summary: Pass at the audited head ff4e009. Both earlier blockers are fixed with real failing-first tests. The token log blocker of review-a-2fdb8f8 is fixed in f88f9b6: read_tokens of both runners reads the old step-finish top-level tokens and the real step_finish part.tokens of the installed bundle. I reproduced the defect first: the pre-fix reader printed 0 0 0 0 0 0 on the real stream, and the post-fix reader prints the sums on both shapes. All nine gate files pass one file at a time with fakes only, the counts match the plan rows 4.13u to 4.13x, and no process of mine stayed alive.

I ran the pre-fix read_tokens, extracted verbatim from git show 0b52f33:harness/model-guide/judge-run.sh, on a real-shape stream: it printed 0 0 0 0 0 0. The post-fix function of both runners printed 10 20 5 100 7 1 on the real shape and on the old shape. The two runner blocks are byte-identical (diff of the two read_tokens functions printed nothing).

The Red tests of 4.13w are real: W1, W2, and W3 of review-run.test.ts assert the summed real tokens, the per-diff tokens, and tokens_complete true; WJ2 of judge-run.test.ts asserts the same for the run record; P3 of decode-parity.test.ts asserts the same through the judge runner. Each assertion fails when read_tokens returns zeros, and my probe shows the pre-fix reader returns zeros on the real stream. The Red record measure/runs/model_guide/red-4.13w.log lists W1, W2, W3, WJ1, WJ2, and P3 as failing. Spec D13 token fields hold: write_record of review-run.sh:658-684 builds per-diff tokens with total as the sum of the five parts, flat totals, and tokens_complete from TOKENS_ALL; TOKENS_ALL turns 0 when any call flag is not 1 (review-run.sh:1057); write_probe_record at review-run.sh:834-842 builds the same fields for the probe. The judge record holds the run totals, the per-group tokens, and tokens_complete (judge-run.sh:818-823). A call with no token event adds 0 and sets the flag false, which the probe verified.

The three decoder copies agree at HEAD: diff of adjudicate.ts:223-250 against review-score.ts:233-260 printed IDENTICAL, and the focus range changed only the decoder comment of review-score.ts. The inline decoder of judge-run.sh is untouched by the range, and decode-parity.test.ts drives all three readers through their public paths (score, queue, judge run) with one real stream: text events joined in order, step and tool events ignored, the verdict map read, and the real tokens logged. The file gave 3 passed (3).

The queue blocker of review-b-2fdb8f8 stays closed: bc0391f added decodeAnswerText to adjudicate.ts and readFindings calls it before the fence parse (adjudicate.ts:255-256 in the range diff). Review C verified the failing-first property at 0b52f33 with a node check on the pre-fix readFindings. My gates confirm the current state: adjudicate 23 passed (23) and review-score 27 passed (27).
